line: Your Instagram views are losing to TikTok right now.
Your automation pulls Instagram's numbers into a column. It looks correct.
Then it pulls TikTok's numbers into that exact same column.
And it quietly overwrites Instagram's real number with TikTok's.
No error. No warning. The column still looks completely normal.
It's just the wrong platform's number now.
This happens the second two platforms feed one shared field.
Give every platform its own column. Never let two platforms write to the same one.
If a number ever looks wrong and you can't explain why — that's the first thing to check.
